task_scope: Read-only plan for three existing view handlers; source owner did not modify repository or frozen entity candidates.
recommendation: Implement view.create, view.update and view.render_data together as one bounded view-session contract group using existing generator types; no generator/Value/registry/SelectionService expansion is needed.
reason: Simple strings plus optional/required allow-empty entity ID arrays express all current inputs. uint64 view revisions stay validated decimal strings, avoiding lossy numbers or uint32 restrictions. Existing auxiliary_write effect expresses disposable session state, while legacy discovery retains session_write.

operations.state_effect: Creates a caller-owned disposable session with view revision 1; valid create prunes other document/epoch sessions before live quota admission; no model/history/store commit.

Inspects owner/document/epoch without requiring current model revision, checks expected_view_revision before rebind, increments view revision only for changed hidden/camera/model revision; lazy handle invalidation; no model/history/store commit.
Strictly requires a view at current model revision; optional expected_view_revision check; returns existing points/beams/geometry_lines render packet, without UI rendering or state mutation.

raw_compatibility.document_identity: Nonempty strings; no trimming, so whitespace input reaches snapshot diagnostics.
raw_compatibility.expected_revision: Required nonempty string parsed by std::from_chars into uint64; accepts zero and leading zeros, rejects sign/whitespace/overflow; compare with snapshot before parameters.
raw_compatibility.view_session_id: Required nonempty string, including syntactically valid whitespace; service owns existence/ownership/epoch/model checks; do not use entity_id type.
raw_compatibility.expected_view_revision: Required update, optional render; exact uint64 decimal string with zero/leading zeros parser semantics; do not use positive_uint32 or finite_number.
raw_compatibility.hidden_ids: Optional create defaults []; required update, [] legal, raw duplicates legal; every member must be a nonempty string; preserve whitespace and service validates existing query-visible identity. Normalize duplicates only in semantic projection, preserving eventual service sort/unique output.
raw_compatibility.camera_fingerprint: Optional create defaults empty; required update; any string including empty and whitespace; no invented max length or trimming.
raw_compatibility.unused_idempotency_key: Ignored top-level arbitrary JSON; schema {}; no new idempotency behavior or write key.
raw_compatibility.expected_profile: Still globally rejected by existing compatibility guard.

error_order: Existing envelope/API/known operation/parameters-object checks and expected_profile rejection stay first.
New shared version_rejection must execute before dispatch_selection snapshot, once added to generated admission; it may add only requested_version named errors.
Omitted/v1: parse document_id then document_epoch -> RecordApplication snapshot -> expected_revision parse and model revision comparison -> parameters.
create: closed fields check -> both optional raw argument checks -> generated semantic projection -> SelectionService::create_view.

update/render: parse view_session_id before closed fields check -> inspect_view for update or get_view for render -> required/optional expected_view_revision parse/comparison -> operation-specific closed fields check -> remaining raw arguments/projection -> existing service call.
Update must retain inspect_view rather than get_view so a stale model view can rebind only after matching the old view revision.
Legacy BadSelectionRequest and encode failure envelopes omit diagnostic field; preserve this even though core service diagnostics include fields.
evaluation_order_caveat: Existing create/update parse hidden IDs and camera in separate C++ function argument expressions; their mutual evaluation order is not language-defined. Preserve guaranteed context/service/fields ordering; do not invent a historical deterministic winner for simultaneous malformed hidden_ids and camera. Before implementation validation, capture actual existing product behavior if exact same-toolchain envelope equivalence for that combined case is required.

add: wire_output_type repeating existing serializer label only
discovery.parameters_schema: Exact legacy names and types, no uniqueItems, no fixed camera/view ID constraints; uint64 fields described as strings with engine parser semantics. No pattern because existing MCP explicit-schema checker does not admit it.
discovery.arguments_schema: Only parameters, document_id, document_epoch, expected_revision, idempotency_key and requested_version; same parameters schema value; identities/revision nonempty strings, unused key {}, optional positive uint32 requested_version. create parameters optional because MCP supplies {}; update/render required.
discovery.mcp: Reuse existing arguments_schema passthrough; no new MCP production routes or validators.
discovery.caller_fact: Production engine currently supplies the same trusted local-user principal for CLI and both MCP clients. Verify shared caller-owned views across these clients; cross-principal rejection belongs in direct C++ tests with explicit trusted Callers, not fabricated JSON actor fields.

existing_regressions_to_reuse: desktop_selection existing scope and known failure boundaries
state_protection: All operations: complete DocumentView/metadata/save token/dirty/generation/history/retained operation facts/store I/O remain identical because no document commit path is called.
New version/schema/raw admission refusals: no create/update/render service invocation, so no new session ID/view revision/quota use or rebase.
Success create changes disposable session tables and ID sequence by existing service behavior; do not assert universal state immutability.

Success update changes only the existing view when hidden/camera/model revision differ; no-op update preserves view revision and handles; actual change invalidates old handles through existing lazy revision checks.
Existing create prunes stale document/epoch sessions before live-view quota admission; do not falsely claim every legacy business-level failed create leaves every disposable session table untouched.
validation_plan: One frozen group validation across existing generation/header/design/format/diff gates and relevant core/local/SQLite/packageON/OFF configurations, with exact same-envelope omitted/v1 comparisons adjusted for fresh view IDs and request correlation, raw/null/extra/context/version precedence cases, duplicate/empty hidden set and unchanged/changed/rebased views, real SQLite shared MCP/CLI workflow, and persistent/session effects recorded separately.
fallback: No simpler replacement group is needed: current view group is expressible without new abstractions. Keep recursive selection.evaluate and conditional previews for later.
acceptance_boundary: Static planning only for REQ-16/TST-F08/TST-A01/QG-02, not delivery or full REQ-16/SK/P0 acceptance. Existing graphical/real-solver/real-AI/performance boundaries stay open.
